purpose: Separate licensed photo uses by verified view: exterior facade panels require facade_eligible/view_type/visual_qa; interior reference photos require interior_reference_eligible/interior_view_type/interior_visual_qa. Never put an interior photo on an exterior wall.
limitations: These are landmark reference photographs, not a complete set for every Shariatpur building.
OSM name matching is not proof of surveyed coordinates; inspect the resulting GLB before release.
CC BY-SA 4.0 texture derivatives must remain available under compatible share-alike terms; keep each photo and attribution separate from unrelated game assets.
No Google Maps imagery is downloaded or redistributed.
Unverified candidate images are excluded from facade panel baking, even when downloaded, licensed, and name-matched.
Interior photographs must never be baked onto building exteriors; a candidate can be enabled only after visual confirmation of an exterior view and its mapped-building match.
